sub_heading_notes.text: In this Chapter, the following expressions have the meanings hereby assigned to them: (a) Tin, not alloyed: Metal containing by weight at least 99% of tin, provided that the content by weight of any bismuth or copper is less than the limit specified in the following Table: TABLE ? OTHER ELEMENTS Element Limiting content % by weight Bi BISMUTH 0.1 Cu COPPER 0.4 (b) Tin alloys: Metallic substances in which tin predominates by weight over each of the other elements, provided that: (i) the total content by weight of such other elements exceeds 1%; or (ii) the content by weight of either bismuth or copper is equal to or greater than the limit specified in the foregoing table
